_note: Things a model cannot do by itself, and the skills, programs and keys that give it the ability. A task that needs one gets its provider skill attached and, if a program or key is missing, a setup step. `triggers` are [regex, weight] pairs matched on the task (weights add up, capped at 1; a capability counts from 0.5). `project` lists project terms (from the fingerprint) that add 0.3. `skills` are in the order to use them; the first is attached by the hive, the rest are preloaded. `apps` are ids in apps/apps.json; `env` are variable names to check (never their values).

capabilities.name: Make 3D models from images or text
capabilities.why: A model cannot produce a 3D mesh itself. It needs an image-to-3D service and Blender to clean and render the result.

capabilities.name: Read websites and platforms
capabilities.why: A model cannot open pages or sign in to platforms. It needs a browsing or reading tool, and a scraper if the job repeats.

capabilities.name: Keep working when a model runs out
capabilities.why: One model has limits. SFP's own router (your local models first, free tiers next) or a gateway sends the work on to another model before the limit stops you.
triggers: \b(rate.?limit|rate limited|quota|429|out of tokens|run out of (tokens|credits|limit)|token limit|usage limit|limit (is |has )?(run|reached|hit))\b
\b(free (llm|model|tier)s?|fallback model|fail ?over|cheaper model|route (requests|between)|many providers|multiple providers|llm gateway|api gateway for)\b

capabilities.name: Find a free API for a need
capabilities.why: A model does not know every API and invents endpoints. A searchable list of real, free APIs gives it ones that exist.

capabilities.name: Generate images, video or voice
capabilities.why: A model cannot draw, film or speak. It calls a media generation service, or renders video from code.

capabilities.name: Check the work in a real browser
capabilities.why: A model cannot see the page it built. A browser driver clicks through it, takes screenshots and finds what is broken.

capabilities.name: Remember earlier sessions
capabilities.why: A model forgets between sessions. A memory tool searches what was done before and why.

capabilities.name: Test an application for security holes
capabilities.why: A model reading code finds some bugs but cannot attack a running app. A scanner probes it the way an attacker would.
